instructions.name: add_xp
docs: Add XP to a player's progression account.
`reason` codes: 1=battle_win(50), 2=battle_loss(15), 3=card_collect(10),
4=super_effective(20), 5=zk_cycle(30), 6=deathrattle(15), 7=chain(15)
Level is recomputed from total XP using xpForLevel(n) = floor((n-1)*n*55).
PDA seeds: `["player_level", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

instructions.name: burn_card
docs: v3.0-plus: Permanently burn a Common or Uncommon NFT card.
Legendary (rarity=3) and Rare (rarity=2) are protected.
Updates CardBattleHistory.burn_count and SeasonStats.total_burned.
Seeds for season_stats PDA: ["season_stats", season_id_le].

accounts.name: card_token_account
docs: Owner's ATA for this NFT mint.

instructions.name: buy_pack
docs: Purchase a card pack (Standard: 5 cards / Premium: 3 cards + Uncommon guarantee).
Transfers SOL 50/50 to ops_treasury and prize_pool.
Uses SlotHashes sysvar for on-chain verifiable randomness.
Drop rates are admin-adjustable via update_game_params.

instructions.name: check_legendary_v2
docs: Check all 6 Legendary acquisition conditions for the calling player.
Called after each battle, x402 payment, or peek action.
Awards up to one Legendary card per condition that becomes satisfied.
O(1) per condition — uses pre-tracked counters on PlayerState.
Requires game_status == 1 (active season).

instructions.name: claim_battle_loot
docs: Claim 1 random card from loser's battle field (on-chain loot via SlotHashes).
`duel_id`:     unique Pubkey for this duel (prevents double-claim via PDA init).
`loser_pubkey`: the loser's wallet pubkey.
`loser_field`:  the 5 card IDs the loser had on the field (0 = empty slot).

accounts.name: duel_loot_record
docs: Initialized here — its existence means loot was claimed (double-spend guard).

instructions.name: claim_prize
docs: Claim the full prize pool after winning a game.
- Verifies `game.status == Finished` and `game.winner == signer`.
- Transfers entire `stake_vault` balance to the winner.
- Uses PDA signer (no admin key required).

instructions.name: claim_prize_v2
docs: Claim tier-based prize after season ends (game_status == 2).
Distributes prize proportional to vault_count:
Tier 1 (60 cards): 50% / winner_60_count
Tier 2 (50-59):    25% × vault_count / tier2_total_vault
Tier 3 (30-49):    15% × vault_count / tier3_total_vault
Tier 4 (10-29):     8% × vault_count / tier4_total_vault
Tier 5  (1-9):      2% × vault_count / tier5_total_vault
If no Tier 1 winner (timeout), player with highest vault_count gets Tier 1.

accounts.name: prize_pool
docs: Prize pool vault.

instructions.name: commit_action
docs: Commit a hidden action for the current round.
`hash = SHA-256(card_ids_le_bytes || salt || round || phase)` (Reborn)
or SHA-256(action_type | target | salt) (Phase C legacy).
Reborn Day 8: `phase` and `played_cards` are now explicit params.
phase: 0=Draw, 1=Energy, 2=Summon, 3=Battle
played_cards: card IDs committed this phase (up to 3; empty for legacy)

instructions.name: commit_card
docs: Submit a ZK card commitment for the 2-phase bluff battle.
The player computes `commitment = SHA256(card_id | salt)` in the browser
and sends it before seeing the opponent's choice. Both players commit
before either reveals — preventing last-mover advantage.
PDA seeds: `["card_commit", player_pubkey, game_id_le, round_u8]`

instructions.name: create_game
docs: Create a new game session.
- Allocates `game` PDA and `card_pool` PDA.
- Sets `status = Lobby`, `round = 0`.
- `max_players` must be 2–4.
Caller becomes the host; only the host may call `start_game`.

instructions.name: create_season
docs: Create a competitive season with a shared entry fee and prize pool.
Seasons run for `duration_seconds` wall-clock time. Players pay `entry_fee`
lamports to register; the accumulated pool is distributed at `end_season`.

instructions.name: deactivate_agent
docs: Deactivate an AI agent listing (soft-delete; agent data is preserved).
Only the agent's original registrant may deactivate. Deactivated agents
are hidden from discovery but remain on-chain for audit purposes.

instructions.name: delegate_session
docs: Delegate game + player_state accounts to the MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup.
Must be called on base layer before routing transactions via the Magic Router.
After delegation, `commit_action` and `reveal_action` should be sent to the
ER validator (via Magic Router) for 10-50ms latency instead of ~400ms.
Calls the MagicBlock Delegation Program CPI for both `game` and `player_state` PDAs.

instructions.name: deposit_stake
docs: Deposit entry stake (0.5 SOL) into the game's prize vault PDA.
- Callable by any participant before or during the game.
- Funds are held in `stake_vault` PDA owned by the program.
- No EOA can withdraw directly — only `claim_prize` can release funds.
Approximate CU cost: ~3,500 (SystemProgram::transfer CPI).

instructions.name: end_season
docs: End a season, compute leaderboard, and emit results.
Emits final standings so clients can display the leaderboard.
Prize distribution logic is handled off-chain based on emitted events.

instructions.name: enter_queue
docs: Enter the matchmaking queue for the given tier (0=Bronze, 1=Silver, 2=Gold).
Tier gates:
Bronze (0): open
Silver (1): requires wins_at_tier[0] >= 5
Gold   (2): requires wins_at_tier[1] >= 3
Emits QueueMatchReady when queue length reaches 2.
PDA seeds: `["queue", tier_u8, season_le_u16]` (init_if_needed)

accounts.name: player_state
docs: We only read current_queue; caller must pass their PlayerState if they have one.

instructions.name: evolve_cards
docs: v3.0-plus: Evolve two Common parent NFTs into one Uncommon child NFT.
Burns parent_a and parent_b via SPL Token CPI.
Inits child CardBattleHistory with provenance (evolved_from_a/b,
cumulative_wins, Evolved+EvolvedHalo imprints).
Updates SeasonStats (+2 burned, +1 evolved, +1 minted).

instructions.name: grant_imprint
docs: v3.0-plus: Grant an Imprint to a card's battle history.
Cosmetic Imprints have no cap. Stat Imprints are capped by rarity:
Common/Uncommon → 3, Rare → 4, Legendary → 5.

accounts.name: player_1
docs: Player 1 in the matched pair

accounts.name: player_2
docs: Player 2 in the matched pair

accounts.name: authority
docs: Matchmaking authority (server wallet) that pays for PDA creation

instructions.name: init_game_world
docs: Initialize the Season 1 GameWorld singleton PDA.
Admin-only (ADMIN_PUBKEY). Can only be called once (init constraint).
`game_start_timestamp`: Unix timestamp when the game goes active.
waitlist_close = game_start - 14 days
end            = game_start + 14 days
PDA seeds: ["game_world"]

instructions.name: init_position
docs: Set a player's initial dungeon position commitment.
Called once after join_game.  commitment = Poseidon(x, y, area, salt).

instructions.name: init_season_stats
docs: v3.0-plus: Initialize the SeasonStats PDA for a new season.
Must be called once before Burn/Evolve/Steal instructions.
Seeds: ["season_stats", season_id_le]

instructions.name: init_season_supply
docs: Initialize or reset season card supply for N participants.
PDA: ["season_supply", season_id_le]

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time program initializer (idempotent; can be skipped in production).

instructions.name: join_game
docs: Join an open game session.
- Allocates a `player_state` PDA for the signer.
- Fails if `game.status != Lobby` or `game.player_count == game.max_players`.
- Initializes starting hand: 1 random card drawn from the pool.

instructions.name: leave_queue
docs: Leave the matchmaking queue for the given tier.
Fails with NotInQueue if the player is not currently in the queue.
PDA seeds: `["queue", tier_u8, season_le_u16]`

instructions.name: lock_deck
docs: Lock the player's deck for 1 hour (3600 seconds).
A locked deck cannot be modified until the timer expires.
The client requires `locked_until > now` before allowing dungeon entry.
Re-locking refreshes the timer from *now* (not from the old expiry).

instructions.name: migrate_shop_fields
docs: Admin-only: reallocate GameWorld PDA to Phase 20-B size and initialize shop fields.
Must be called once after program upgrade from a pre-Phase-20-B deployment.
Sets ops_treasury, prize_pool, and all drop rate defaults.

instructions.name: record_battle_result
docs: Record a card battle outcome for combo tracking.
`is_super_effective = true` increments the combo streak.
Hitting 3/5/7 unlocks combo tiers (PERFECT/LEGENDARY/UNSTOPPABLE).
At 7+ the xp_2x_flag is set for the next add_xp call.
PDA seeds: `["player_battle_stats", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

accounts.name: current_owner
docs: The current owner being displaced.

instructions.name: record_card_owner_change_with_steal
docs: v3.0-plus: Record owner change with Steal semantics (Lease/Ransom/HandPeek/Legendary).

instructions.name: record_mint
docs: Record a card mint against the season supply, with tier fallback.
Returns the tier actually used (may be lower than requested if exhausted).

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Register an AI agent in the on-chain agent marketplace.
Agents are identified by a `name_hash` (SHA-256 of human-readable name).
`strategy_hash` and `endpoint_hash` let clients discover agent capabilities
without revealing the agent's internal logic or private endpoint URL.
`price_per_query` is in lamports — paid via x402 micropayment protocol.

instructions.name: register_agent_hire
docs: Register an on-chain AgentHireSession after x402 payment verification.
The hirer calls this after the x402 facilitator confirms the 0.05 SOL
payment. `payment_tx` links the session to the Solana payment tx for
audit purposes. The AgentListing must be active.
PDA seeds: `["agent_hire", hirer_pubkey, agent_id_le_bytes]`

accounts.name: agent_listing
docs: The AgentListing PDA — must be active before hire is valid.

instructions.name: register_card
docs: Register a card species in the player's permanent registry (GI rule).
First time a player acquires card species X → registered[X] = true (permanent).
Subsequent copies → does not change registry (card is battle-consumable extra).
When count reaches 60 → season_complete = true.
PDA seeds: `["player_registry", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

instructions.name: register_waitlist
docs: Register on the Season 1 waitlist.
Deposits 0.5 SOL (85% → prize_pool, 15% → ops_treasury).
Initializes PlayerState v2 fields and distributes 5 starter cards.
Callable only while `game_world.waitlist_close_timestamp > now`.
PDA seeds: `["player", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

accounts.name: prize_pool
docs: Prize pool vault (system account; receives 85% of deposit).

accounts.name: ops_treasury
docs: Operations treasury (receives 15% of deposit).

instructions.name: resolve_round
docs: Resolve the current round after all players have revealed.
Resolution order (simultaneous semantics, caller-triggered):
1. BARRIER — players raising barriers are flagged.
2. STEAL — transfers a random card from victim to stealer; blocked if victim has BARRIER.
3. DRAW — gives caller the top card from the shared pool for their area.
4. SCOUT — records target's revealed action for client-side intel display.
5. MOVE — updates `player_state.area`.
6. USE_CARD — applies card effect; removes card from hand.
Emits `RoundResolved` event. Transitions back to `CommitPhase` for next round,
or to `Finished` if win condition met (player holds all 5 unique card types).

accounts.name: caller
docs: All player states passed as remaining accounts

instructions.name: reveal_action
docs: Reveal the previously committed action and verify hash.
Reborn path (played_cards non-empty):
SHA-256(card_ids_le_bytes || salt || round || phase)
Verified played_cards written into CommitAction for lane resolution.
Legacy path (played_cards empty):
SHA-256(action_type | target | salt)

accounts.name: commit
docs: Mutable so we can write verified played_cards back for resolve_round lane scoring.

instructions.name: reveal_card
docs: Reveal the previously committed card.
On-chain verifies `SHA256(card_id | salt) == stored_commitment`.
After both players reveal, `resolve_round` fires with element multipliers.
Full Groth16/Poseidon ZK verification targets Mainnet v1 —
the circuit `card_commit.circom` is ready; MVP uses SHA-256.

instructions.name: save_deck
docs: Save or update the player's prepared battle deck.
PDA seeds: `["player_deck", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)
Validates composition before storing:
- card IDs 1-60 only; 0 = empty (rejected)
- total cost ≤ 30  (Common=1, Rare=2, Legendary=5)
- Legendary cards ≤ 2
- Rare cards ≤ 6
GDD v1.2: exactly 20 cards, max 2 copies of any card_id.
lane_assignments: 0=Front 1=Middle 2=Back 255=Any; empty vec → all 255.
deck must be unlocked (locked_until == 0 OR now ≥ locked_until)

instructions.name: set_title
docs: Equip a previously unlocked title.
Fails with InvalidAction if the title is not yet unlocked.
PDA seeds: `["player_title", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

instructions.name: start_game
docs: Start the game and deal opening hands.
- Restricted to the game host.
- Transitions `status: Lobby → CommitPhase`.
- Shuffles `card_pool` using recent slot hash as PRNG seed.
- Deals 3 cards to each player; remaining cards stay in pool.

accounts.name: host
docs: Player states passed as remaining accounts

instructions.name: undelegate_session
docs: Schedule commit + undelegate for game + player_state via the Magic Program.
Must be sent to the ER validator (not base layer). The ER processes this,
commits all pending state diffs to base layer, then calls the Delegation
Program's Undelegate instruction to restore account ownership to this program.

instructions.name: unlock_achievement
docs: Unlock an achievement for the calling player.
Achievement indices 0-9:
0=first_blood, 1=collector_10, 2=collector_30, 3=full_set,
4=chain_master, 5=dr_survived, 6=zk_committed, 7=super_x5,
8=dungeon_floor5, 9=season_top
Already-unlocked achievements are a no-op (idempotent).
PDA seeds: `["player_achievements", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

instructions.name: unlock_lore_shard
docs: Unlock a lore shard for a card the player owns.
Shard indices:
0 = Shard 1 — auto-unlocked on card acquisition
1 = Shard 2 — unlocked by duel participation with card in deck
2 = Shard 3 — unlocked via Gold Hall win or x402 payment
Method codes: 0=auto, 1=condition_met, 2=x402_payment
Idempotent: calling for an already-unlocked shard is a no-op.
Emits `LoreShardUnlocked` event.
PDA seeds: `["card_lore_shards", card_mint, owner_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

instructions.name: unlock_title
docs: Unlock a title badge for the calling player.
Title indices 0-7:
0=Traveler (always on), 1=Card Hunter, 2=Chain Wizard,
3=Dread Pirate, 4=ZK Mystic, 5=Half-Deck, 6=The Collector, 7=Champion
PDA seeds: `["player_title", player_pubkey]` (init_if_needed)

instructions.name: update_game_params
docs: Admin-only: adjust shop drop rates and phase threshold.
All rate params are in ppm (parts per million out of 1_000_000).
Pass `None` for any param to leave it unchanged.
Legendary rates are validated ≤ 100_000 (10%).

instructions.name: verify_dungeon_move
docs: Verify a Groth16 ZK proof that the player made a valid dungeon move.
Circuit: dungeon_position.circom (625 constraints, BN254 / Groth16)
Public inputs (64 bytes): old_commitment[0..32] || new_commitment[32..64]
Proof generation: snarkjs in browser WASM (<1s for 625 constraints)

instructions.name: verify_zk_proof
docs: Verify a Groth16 ZK proof for a committed action.
The proof attests that `Poseidon(action, target, salt) == commitment_hash`
without revealing `action`, `target`, or `salt` on-chain.
- Circuit: `zk/circuits/commit_reveal.circom` (277 constraints, BN254 curve)
- Proving key: `zk/build/commit_reveal_final.zkey`
- Verification key: `zk/build/verification_key.json`
This instruction is optional — standard `reveal_action` provides the same
correctness guarantee. ZK proof adds an additional privacy layer when the
client wishes to hide action metadata from on-chain observers.
Approximate CU cost: 80,000–200,000 (BN254 pairing). Budget 300,000.

accounts.name: zk_proof_record
docs: Replay prevention — `init` fails if the PDA already exists (already verified).

instructions.name: create_listing
docs: Create a sell listing, escrowing the card from the seller's vault.
card_id must be owned by seller. Price must be >= 0.001 SOL.
Card is removed from vault immediately. TradeListing PDA is initialized.

instructions.name: cancel_listing
docs: Cancel an active listing and return the escrowed card to the seller.
Only the original seller may cancel. TradeListing PDA is closed; rent refunded.

instructions.name: accept_listing
docs: Purchase a listed card.
Buyer pays price in SOL directly to seller (0% fee).
Card is added to buyer's vault. TradeListing PDA is closed.

types.name: AgentHireSession
docs: On-chain record of an x402-paid agent hire session.
Created by the hirer after completing the x402 payment to the facilitator.
The `payment_tx` field stores the Solana tx signature that was verified by
the facilitator — providing a verifiable audit trail linking the hire to
the actual SOL payment.
PDA seeds: `["agent_hire", hirer_pubkey, agent_id_le_bytes]`

fields.name: payment_tx_lo
docs: First 32 bytes of the Solana tx signature that funded the x402 payment.
Full sig is stored off-chain; this field provides an on-chain audit link.

types.name: AgentListing
docs: Agent Registry — On-chain marketplace for AI agents.
Developers register their agents with strategy descriptions and pricing.
Players can browse and hire agents to play on their behalf.
Revenue model: Agent earns 95% of intel revenue, platform takes 5%.

types.name: CardBattleHistory
docs: Per-NFT battle statistics PDA (v3.0-plus extended).
Seed: ["card_battle_history", card_mint]
v3.0-plus: added burn/evolve/imprint/lease fields at end.
Devnet: existing PDAs must be closed and re-initted post-deploy (r0ze approved).

types.name: CardCommitRecord
docs: ZK card commitment record for 2-phase bluff battle (Axis C).
PDA seeds: ["card_commit", player_pubkey, game_id_le, round_u8]
Phase 1 (COMMIT): player sends commitment = Poseidon(card_id, salt).
Phase 2 (REVEAL): player sends (card_id, salt, zk_proof); on-chain
verifies Poseidon(card_id, salt) == stored commitment before revealing.

fields.name: commitment
docs: Poseidon(card_id, salt) — 32-byte big-endian field element.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Set to true after reveal_card verifies the ZK proof.

fields.name: card_id
docs: 0 until reveal phase; populated after valid reveal.

types.name: CardLoreShards
docs: Per-card lore discovery tracker (3 shards per card).
Shard 0: Auto-unlocked on first acquisition.
Shard 1: Unlocked by playing a duel with this card in the active deck.
Shard 2: Unlocked via Gold Hall win or direct x402 payment.
PDA seeds: ["card_lore_shards", card_mint, owner_pubkey]

fields.name: remaining
docs: Remaining cards per type: index 0 = Crystal, 1 = Shadow, etc.

fields.name: round_number
docs: Round number from Game.round at commit time (Reborn: 0-based round index).

fields.name: phase
docs: Duel phase at commit time: 0=Draw, 1=Energy, 2=Summon, 3=Battle.

fields.name: played_cards
docs: Cards played in this phase commit (up to 3 card IDs; 0 = empty slot).
Reborn: commitment = SHA-256(played_cards + nonce + round + phase).

fields.name: played_cards_len
docs: Number of valid card IDs stored in played_cards (0-3).

types.name: DuelState
docs: Per-duel on-chain state for commit-reveal ZK hand system.
Both players commit their hands via Groth16 ZK proof at Lock In,
then reveal after battle resolves.
PDA seeds: ["duel", duel_id.as_ref()]

fields.name: id
docs: Unique duel identifier (random Pubkey generated at matchmaking)

fields.name: player_1_commitment
docs: Poseidon commitment per round per player (index: [round-1], 0-indexed)
Stored as 32-byte big-endian BN254 field element

fields.name: player_1_revealed
docs: Revealed card IDs after battle (10 cards × 5 rounds)

types.name: GameStatus
docs: Card types (1-indexed, 0 = empty)
1=Aegis (Crystal Knight), 2=Umbra (Shadow Rogue), 3=Ignis (Fire Beast), 4=Tempest (Storm Prophet), 5=Nihil (Void Observer)

types.name: GameWorld
docs: Global singleton for Season 1 state.
PDA seeds: ["game_world"]

fields.name: legendary_acquired_count
docs: How many players have acquired each Legendary (max 10 each).

fields.name: game_status
docs: 0=waitlist, 1=active, 2=ended

fields.name: tier2_total_vault
docs: Tier participant counts (set during finalize_game for claim_prize).

fields.name: shop_phase_threshold_seconds
docs: Seconds after game_start at which Phase 2 drop rates activate (default 7 days).

fields.name: legendary_drop_rate_phase1
docs: Drop rates in ppm (parts per million, out of 1_000_000). u32 required for uncommon (180000).

types.name: Imprint
docs: Single imprint entry — 22 bytes (fixed-size).

types.name: LegendaryAcquired
docs: Emitted when a player acquires a Legendary card (realtime judgment).

types.name: LegendarySupply
docs: Per-season Legendary supply PDA.
Seed: ["legendary_supply", season_id.to_le_bytes()]
Tracks 4 Legendary species: Sceptre(0), Nameless Blade(1), Elyon Crown(2), Kingmaker's Ring(3)

fields.name: minted
docs: minted[i] = how many of species i have been minted (0-10)

fields.name: cap
docs: cap[i]    = max allowed per species per season (default 10)

types.name: LoreShardUnlocked
docs: Emitted when a lore shard is unlocked for a card.

types.name: MatchmakingQueue
docs: FIFO queue per tier per season. Max 64 players.
When queue length reaches 2 after a push, emits QueueMatchReady.
PDA seeds: ["queue", tier_u8, season_le_u16]

types.name: PlayerAchievements
docs: Per-player achievement flags (10 achievements, bitmask in u16).
Bit i = achievement index i unlocked.
PDA seeds: ["player_achievements", player_pubkey]
Achievement indices:
0=first_blood, 1=collector_10, 2=collector_30, 3=full_set,
4=chain_master, 5=dr_survived, 6=zk_committed, 7=super_x5,
8=dungeon_floor5, 9=season_top

types.name: PlayerBattleStats
docs: Per-player battle combo and streak tracking.
combo_count resets on non-SUPER-EFFECTIVE battle outcome.
PDA seeds: ["player_battle_stats", player_pubkey]

fields.name: wins_at_tier
docs: Wins per matchmaking tier: [0]=Bronze, [1]=Silver, [2]=Gold.
Used to gate access: Silver requires wins_at_tier[0] >= 5, Gold requires wins_at_tier[1] >= 3.

types.name: PlayerDeck
docs: Player's prepared battle deck (up to 20 cards).
PDA seeds: ["player_deck", player_pubkey]
Composition rules (GDD v1.2 — simplified from Phase C):
- exactly 20 cards
- max 2 copies of any single card
(Phase C cost cap + rarity balance removed)
DECISION (2026-04-22): Added lane_assignments [u8; 20] field.
Values: 0=Front, 1=Middle, 2=Back, 255=Any (default).
Existing accounts that were init_if_needed before this change have
zero-padding in the new bytes, which is treated as Front (0). Clients
should write 255 (Any) for all lanes when saving a deck without lane data.
SIZE updated from 78 → 98 bytes; new accounts created after this deploy
will be allocated correctly via init_if_needed.

fields.name: deck_cards
docs: Card IDs in deck (0 = empty slot). Always exactly 20 entries.

fields.name: locked_until
docs: Unix timestamp until which the deck is locked (0 = not locked).

fields.name: lane_assignments
docs: Lane assignment per deck slot. 0=Front, 1=Middle, 2=Back, 255=Any.
Defaults to 255 (Any) when not explicitly set.

types.name: PlayerDuelStats

types.name: PlayerLevel

xpForLevel(n) = floor((n-1)*n*55), 60 levels.

types.name: PlayerRegistry

First acquisition of species X sets registered[X-1] = true (permanent).

fields.name: registered

fields.name: registered_at
docs: unix timestamp of first registration, 0 if not registered

fields.name: count
docs: total distinct species registered

fields.name: season_complete
docs: true when count == 60 (all species collected)

fields.name: cards
docs: Cards held: array of 5 slots, value = card_id (1-5), 0 = empty

fields.name: revealed_action
docs: Revealed action (stored after reveal, used during resolution)

fields.name: move_target

fields.name: card_timestamps

fields.name: position_commitment

fields.name: current_queue

fields.name: vault_bitmap
docs: Bitmask of owned card IDs (1-60). Bit (id-1) set = owned.

fields.name: deposit_amount

fields.name: win_streak
docs: Current win streak (resets on loss).

fields.name: max_win_streak
docs: All-time max win streak this season.

fields.name: total_matches
docs: Total matches played (for Sage / Architect legendary judgment).

fields.name: last_action_type
docs: action_type of the last committed action (u8, ActionType value).

fields.name: consecutive_diff_actiontype
docs: Consecutive matches where action_type differed from the previous match.

fields.name: x402_total_spend

fields.name: peek_unique_targets

fields.name: no_x402_win_streak
docs: Win streak with zero x402 spend (for Hermit / Ascetic judgment).

fields.name: legendary_progress

fields.name: vault_size_max
docs: Max vault size reached this season (for Phoenix / Marauder judgment).

fields.name: vault_size_min

fields.name: last_drop_to_tier5_timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of last time player dropped to Tier 5 (for Phoenix).

2. Players join via deposit_stake
3. Games play out
